pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Three-Yang Cauldron is an advanced forging vessel capable of holding up to 20 materials. Its expanded capacity makes it suited for recipes requiring numerous ingredients.

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: Like the Bronze Cauldron, its lid can be opened or closed by Shift-right-clicking, and its interface can only be accessed while open.
